error.message: error registering migrations: migration file the Ptah format does not read: seed.sql. Ptah reads a migration directory whole, so it refuses the directory rather than leave this file unapplied; name it NNNNNNNNNN_<name>.up.sql, NNNNNNNNNN_<name>.down.sql or R__<name>.sql, with .up, .down and .sql in lower case, or move it out of the directory
